description: This file contains implementations of font resolver classes for unit testing in the PDFsharp library. The classes include NullFontResolver, TestXFilesFontResolver1, TestXFilesFontResolver2, and TestXFilesFontResolver3, which provide different behaviors for resolving fonts, especially focusing on the 'X-Files' test font.

classes.name: NullFontResolver
classes.description: A font resolver that always returns null, used for testing fallback behavior.

classes.name: TestXFilesFontResolver1
classes.description: Resolves only the 'X-Files' font, does not call platform font resolver, used for testing.

classes.name: TestXFilesFontResolver2
classes.description: Resolves 'X-Files' font and delegates to platform font resolver if not matching.

classes.name: TestXFilesFontResolver3
classes.description: Resolves 'X-Files' font and throws an exception if font is not found, used for testing error handling.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves font typeface based on family name and style directives (bold, italic).

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font data byte array for the given face name.
